title.narrative: Powering Eswatini’s Delivery Engine: The Citizen-Centred UniPod for Jobs, MSME Growth, Digital Innovation & Accountable Service Delivery

description.narrative: The “Powering Eswatini’s Delivery Engine: The Citizen-Centred UniPod for Jobs, MSME Growth, Digital Innovation & Accountable Service Delivery,” seeks to address Eswatini’s persistent challenges of high youth unemployment, low MSME productivity, and weak execution capacity across public institutions. The UniPod—hosted at the University of Eswatini (UNESWA)—is envisioned as a national delivery mechanism that integrates skills development, innovation, enterprise upgrading, and digital governance solutions into a coherent platform capable of generating jobs, MSME growth, and improved service delivery at scale.The overarching purpose of the UniPod is to convert skills, research, innovation, and MSME support into deployable products, services, and employment outcomes. It aims to bridge the execution gap that has historically limited Eswatini’s ability to translate strong policy intent into tangible economic results.More specifically, the project seeks to:• Strengthen national execution capacity by establishing an integrated system of eight production grade laboratories that support innovation, prototyping, digital solutions, and enterprise upgrading.• Accelerate youth and women’s employment by creating demand-linked pathways that convert skills into paid work and enterprise opportunities.• Advance structural economic transformation through industrial upgrading, MSME participation in higher-value chains, and local production capabilities.• Enhance governance and accountability by supporting GovTech solutions, workflow digitisation, and improved public-sector service delivery.• Promote sustainability through co-financing arrangements with ESCCOM, government ministries, and private-sector partners.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).
